source_review.base: Each proof keeps its exact frozen base tree and receives only its corresponding test overlay derived from the measured head. Base build and fixture source digests are retained by run.
source_review.mochi: Both probes supply the prebuilt DiT, mask, text context and initial tensor directly to denoise. The E4 eager-load, CFG text handle and initial-latent lifetime changes affect the full provider around denoise and decode. The direct probe never acquires those handles and its default transformer text width stays 4096.
source_review.scail2: The test-only overlay calls the production scheduler windows with frozen latent carriers. The E4 carrier metadata, scope projection, decoder and working-set pricing do not participate. The source delta does not change the observed scheduler and model inputs.
source_review.scope: Retain only independent measurements of the synthetic direct denoise probes. Product admission, decoding and full-job memory require their own evidence.
source_review.shared: The common phase entry now records a video phase with latent frame count when it receives a scope. These direct probes pass no request scope. The CPU-side PDH verification change leaves original failed pairs inconclusive.
source_review.svd: Both probes construct the UNet and fixed conditioning/sigma inputs. Native MLX Euler and curated Heun plus Candle Euler/Heun execute the same denoise/sampler math. E4 centralizes the equivalent fixed phase shape (2D downsample factor 8) and keeps the direct phase unscoped. Codec load, output decode and conversion are outside the probe.
source_review.wan: The earlier MLX overlay differs only in env parsing, equivalent Heun trace assertions, a BF16/F32-preserving fixture writer extension and CUDA-only files. The measured MLX calls invoke direct curated resident/swapped denoise; the later identity helper extracts the same shape and constructs the same phase for these fixed inputs. Candle calls Pipeline::denoise directly with no request scope. Registered plan, pre-load checks and RGB/decode pricing are outside the probes.
source_review.wan_cuda_timing: The older run 44856440634 used the previous monitoring harness and is excluded from the timed follow-up baseline. The latest retained run 44861650920 is the unresolved comparison.
